slides.title: 5 things people get wrong about **AI with tools**
slides.scene: A nervous shop owner peeks out from behind a counter at a tiny friendly robot holding a feather duster, as if it were a lion; Phoney the blue phone character stands between them like a lion tamer with a little stool and a whistle, looking amused, while the robot politely waits on a doormat. Bright, warm, funny.

items.label: Tech
items.bad: You need a developer to set it up.
items.good: If you can change a setting on your phone, you can add one.

items.label: Brand
items.good: It's an open standard. Claude and ChatGPT both use it.

items.label: Name
items.good: Model Context Protocol: one shared way for AI to use outside tools.

items.label: Control
items.bad: Give AI a tool and it runs wild.
items.good: Ours wait for your yes before anything public, costly or permanent.

items.label: Plan
items.good: Pick one that supports connectors. On Claude, that's a paid plan.

slides.save: 💾 Save this for the next time someone says AI is scary
